eyebrow.purpose: The "One card. Every deck." tagline line and similar kickers.

code.purpose: Decklists, exported marking guides, aligned data columns.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Solid violet, the single primary action per view.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { height: 2.5rem; padding: 0 1rem; border: none; border-radius: 4px; font-family: halyard-micro, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; background: #4d4169; color: #ffffff; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 0.15s ease, box-shadow 0.15s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #3a2e55; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px #eadeff; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.5; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Outlined Button
components.description: Secondary and tertiary actions; white fill with a neutral stroke.
components.css: .ds-btn-outlined { height: 2.5rem; padding: 0 1rem; border: 1px solid #c9c9d3; border-radius: 4px; font-family: halyard-micro, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; background: #ffffff; color: #34353c; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 0.15s ease; } .ds-btn-outlined:hover { background: #f2f2fc; } .ds-btn-outlined:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px #eadeff; }

components.name: Card
components.description: Flat white surface, 1px border, radius 6px, optional hover lift.
components.html:
Commander Precons
3 decks · 2 shared cards
components.css: .ds-card { background: #ffffff; border: 1px solid #c9c9d3; border-radius: 6px; overflow: hidden; transition: box-shadow 0.15s ease; } .ds-card:hover { box-shadow: 0 2px 6px rgba(24,10,46,.10), 0 1px 2px rgba(24,10,46,.06); } .ds-card-header { padding: 14px 21px; border-bottom: 1px solid #c9c9d3; font-family: adobe-aldine, Georgia, serif; font-size: 22px; font-weight: 600; color: #34353c; } .ds-card-body { padding: 21px; font-family: halyard-micro, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; color: #47474f; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: White fill, 1px neutral stroke, brand focus ring.
components.css: .ds-input { height: 2.5rem; padding: 0 0.75rem; border: 1px solid #b0b0b9; border-radius: 4px; background: #ffffff; font-family: halyard-micro, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; color: #34353c; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #76767f; } .ds-input:focus { outline: none; border-color: #7d719c; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px #eadeff; }

components.name: Tag
components.description: Pill tag, brand-subtle fill, used for feature labels and states.
components.css: .ds-tag { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; padding: 0.35em 0.7em; border-radius: 9999px; background: #eadeff; color: #4d4169; font-family: halyard-micro, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1; }

components.name: Stripe Indicator
components.description: PRISM primitive: 18x18 slot marker. Dashed border means empty or unassigned; solid means occupied.
components.css: .ds-stripe { display: inline-block; width: 18px; height: 18px; border-radius: 3px; border: 1px dashed #c9c9d3; background: transparent; margin-right: 4px; } .ds-stripe--filled { border-style: solid; border-color: rgba(0,0,0,0.25); background: var(--stripe-color); }

narrative.overview: Minimal structure, maximal color. The layout is quiet so the color can talk. PRISM is a tool for marking Perfect Fit inner sleeves with colored stripes, so every color in the UI is functional: it either identifies a deck, signals a state, or it does not belong. The mood is clever, clean, confident, direct: a precise workshop instrument, not a toy and not a luxury object. Density is compact and data-heavy; card lists and result tables are meant to be scanned, not admired. Decoration budget is near zero: no gradients, no textures, no patterns, no photography, no blur, no glass. Flat surfaces, 1px borders, one violet accent. Light and dark are both first-class.
keyCharacteristics: Near-zero decoration budget: no gradients, textures, blur, or glass
One violet accent; WUBRG reserved strictly for deck identity

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Let the accent be violet and the field be white. One accent, one job.

rules.name: The Identity-Only Rule
rules.body: WUBRG is identity only: stripes, deck swatches, the logo gem. Never text color, never a state color, never a button fill.

rules.name: The Signature Contrast Rule
rules.body: Serif heading over sans body is the system's signature contrast: editorial headline, instrument body. Never invert it.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Elevation is carried by borders and surface steps first, shadow second. Surfaces are flat at rest.

dos: Use semantic tokens (--wa-color-brand-fill-loud) in app UI; reserve raw ramp steps for marketing and collateral.
Keep WUBRG strictly for stripes, deck swatches, and the gem.
Write in second person with the player as the actor: "Mark your sleeves."
Compose Web Awesome components; extend with css/custom.css only for what WA cannot express.
Load the /webawesome-design skill before building or restyling any page, panel, or layout. Prefer an existing <wa-*> component over a custom-built equivalent every time one is available.
Validate every text/background pair against WCAG AA.
donts: No gradients, textures, patterns, photography, glassmorphism, or blur.
No new fonts beyond halyard-micro, adobe-aldine, Geist Mono.
Never a sans heading over serif body.
No WUBRG color as text, state color, or button fill.
No emoji anywhere in product UI or marketing copy.
No exclamation points and no em-dashes in copy.
No decorative animation, and nothing that moves on scroll.
